mapper.sql: FROM biz_adjustment_admit a LEFT JOIN biz_school s ON s.id = a.school_id

choose.when: AND IFNULL(s.is_985, 0) = 0 AND IFNULL(s.is_211, 0) = 0 AND IFNULL(s.is_syl, 0) = 1
AND IFNULL(s.is_985, 0) = 0 AND IFNULL(s.is_211, 0) = 0 AND IFNULL(s.is_syl, 0) = 0

mapper.select:
SELECT g.school_id AS schoolId, g.school_name AS schoolName, g.college_id AS collegeId, g.college_name AS collegeName, g.major_id AS majorId, g.major_code AS majorCode, g.major_name AS majorName, g.year AS year, g.study_mode AS studyMode, s.province_name AS provinceName, s.province_area AS provinceArea, CASE WHEN IFNULL(s.is_985, 0) = 1 THEN 1 WHEN IFNULL(s.is_211, 0) = 1 THEN 2 WHEN IFNULL(s.is_syl, 0) = 1 THEN 3 ELSE 4 END AS schoolLevel, CASE WHEN IFNULL(s.is_985, 0) = 1 THEN '985工程' WHEN IFNULL(s.is_211, 0) = 1 THEN '211工程' WHEN IFNULL(s.is_syl, 0) = 1 THEN '双一流' ELSE '普通院校' END AS schoolLevelName, CAST(g.first_score AS SIGNED) AS firstScore FROM ( SELECT a.school_id, MAX(a.school_name) AS school_name, a.college_id, MAX(a.college_name) AS college_name, a.major_id, MAX(a.major_code) AS major_code, MAX(a.major_name) AS major_name, a.year, a.study_mode, MAX(a.first_score) AS first_score FROM biz_adjustment_admit a LEFT JOIN biz_school s ON s.id = a.school_id
GROUP BY a.school_id, a.college_id, a.major_id, a.year, a.study_mode ) g LEFT JOIN biz_school s ON s.id = g.school_id
ORDER BY CASE WHEN #{targetMajorCode} IS NOT NULL AND #{targetMajorCode} != '' AND CHAR_LENGTH(#{targetMajorCode}) >= 6 AND g.major_code = #{targetMajorCode} THEN 3 WHEN #{targetMajorCode} IS NOT NULL AND #{targetMajorCode} != '' AND CHAR_LENGTH(#{targetMajorCode}) >= 4 AND CHAR_LENGTH(g.major_code) >= 4 AND LEFT(g.major_code, 4) = LEFT(#{targetMajorCode}, 4) THEN 2 WHEN #{targetMajorCode} IS NOT NULL AND #{targetMajorCode} != '' AND CHAR_LENGTH(#{targetMajorCode}) >= 2 AND CHAR_LENGTH(g.major_code) >= 2 AND LEFT(g.major_code, 2) = LEFT(#{targetMajorCode}, 2) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END DESC, g.first_score DESC, CASE WHEN IFNULL(s.is_985, 0) = 1 THEN 1 WHEN IFNULL(s.is_211, 0) = 1 THEN 2 WHEN IFNULL(s.is_syl, 0) = 1 THEN 3 ELSE 4 END ASC, g.school_id DESC

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ( SELECT a.school_id, a.college_id, a.major_id, a.year, a.study_mode FROM biz_adjustment_admit a LEFT JOIN biz_school s ON s.id = a.school_id
GROUP BY a.school_id, a.college_id, a.major_id, a.year, a.study_mode ) t

SELECT '985工程' AS name, '' AS subName, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN IFNULL(s.is_985, 0) = 1 THEN a.school_id ELSE NULL END) AS value
UNION ALL SELECT '211工程' AS name, '不含985' AS subName, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN IFNULL(s.is_985, 0) = 0 AND IFNULL(s.is_211, 0) = 1 THEN a.school_id ELSE NULL END) AS value
UNION ALL SELECT '双一流' AS name, '不含985、211' AS subName, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN IFNULL(s.is_985, 0) = 0 AND IFNULL(s.is_211, 0) = 0 AND IFNULL(s.is_syl, 0) = 1 THEN a.school_id ELSE NULL END) AS value
UNION ALL SELECT '普通院校' AS name, '' AS subName, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN IFNULL(s.is_985, 0) = 0 AND IFNULL(s.is_211, 0) = 0 AND IFNULL(s.is_syl, 0) = 0 THEN a.school_id ELSE NULL END) AS value

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN IFNULL(s.is_985, 0) = 1 THEN a.school_id ELSE NULL END) AS c985, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN IFNULL(s.is_985, 0) = 0 AND IFNULL(s.is_211, 0) = 1 THEN a.school_id ELSE NULL END) AS c211, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN IFNULL(s.is_985, 0) = 0 AND IFNULL(s.is_211, 0) = 0 AND IFNULL(s.is_syl, 0) = 1 THEN a.school_id ELSE NULL END) AS csyl, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN IFNULL(s.is_985, 0) = 0 AND IFNULL(s.is_211, 0) = 0 AND IFNULL(s.is_syl, 0) = 0 THEN a.school_id ELSE NULL END) AS cother
